name: Nike Field Hockey Camp at Manhattanville University
description_short: Four day field hockey day camp at Manhattanville University in Purchase for girls 10 to 18 of all levels, led by the university's head coach. Morning and afternoon sessions cover stick skills, offense, defense and positioning, with goalkeeper training.
notes: Daily 9 am to 3 pm; check in 30 minutes before start. Campers bring a sack lunch, stick, mouth guard, shin guards and turf shoes. A registration fee is charged once per camper per season (amount not shown on the page). Groups of 4 or more save $25 each, 8 or more save $45 each. No scholarships, citing NCAA rules. No supervision before or after camp hours.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp page, 2027 overview: July 26 to 29, 2027, girls 10 to 18, $489, 9 to 3, lunch and transportation not provided, no scholarships.
